title: Parser drops trailing newline
body: The parser strips the final newline from a heredoc body, so round-tripping a document is not idempotent. Make round-tripping preserve the input byte for byte.
test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/t1.sh b/tests/t1.sh
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ca916d0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/t1.sh
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+exit 0

title: CLI exits 0 on an unknown flag
body: An unrecognized flag is ignored and the process exits 0. It should print the usage block to stderr and exit 2.
test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/t2.sh b/tests/t2.sh
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ca916d0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/t2.sh
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+exit 0

title: Add --json output to the status command
body: Status prints a human table only. Add a --json flag emitting one object with the same fields, so the command can be scripted.
test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/t3.sh b/tests/t3.sh
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ca916d0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/t3.sh
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+exit 0

title: Config loader ignores the environment override
body: Values from the environment are read but never take precedence over the file. Environment should win, and the precedence order should be covered by a test.
test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/t4.sh b/tests/t4.sh
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ca916d0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/t4.sh
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+exit 0

title: Retry helper has no upper bound
body: The retry helper backs off forever. Cap the number of attempts, make the cap a parameter, and default it to five.
test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/t5.sh b/tests/t5.sh
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ca916d0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/t5.sh
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+exit 0

title: Timestamps are formatted in local time
body: Log timestamps use the local zone, so logs from two machines cannot be interleaved. Format them as UTC ISO-8601.
test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/t6.sh b/tests/t6.sh
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ca916d0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/t6.sh
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+exit 0
